votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of January 7, 2025, as well as the formal meeting minutes of November 19, 2024; December 3, 2024; and December 10, 2024.
votes.description: The Council approved multiple sets of prior meeting minutes, covering one work session and three formal sessions from late 2024 and early 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Ceremonial Resolution 03 of 2025 recognizing February as Black History Month in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: The Council and Mayor jointly adopted a ceremonial resolution honoring Black History Month, accepted by representatives of the local NAACP chapter.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-10 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the combined public hearing on ten grant applications and referred all items to a future consent agenda for formal approval.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY 2024-25, adopt the new Cybersecurity Engineer I FTE from Item A-2, and refer the remaining items to a future date.
votes.description: The Council partially acted on the FY2025 Budget Amendment No. 3 by adopting one new FTE position while continuing the public hearing and deferring the remainder of the amendment for future consideration.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 09 of 2025, approving a $350,000 loan for Gorkha Enterprises, DBA Himalayan Kitchen from the Economic Development Loan Fund.
votes.description: The Council approved a $350,000 EDLF loan to Himalayan Kitchen, a downtown Indian and Nepali restaurant, to support job creation and retention.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 02 of 2025, establishing a collective bargaining structure and process for the Salt Lake City Public Library, as amended and approved by the Library Board of Directors on January 29, 2025.
votes.description: The Council approved a resolution enabling the Salt Lake City Public Library to enter into a collective bargaining agreement process with a union following a successful employee union vote.

votes.motion: Approve Item G-1 listed on the Consent Agenda (Ordinance Confirmation: Zoning Map Amendments at approximately 2760, 2800, and 2828 North 2200 West and Board Appointment: Business Advisory Board – Alyn Toalepai).
votes.description: The Council confirmed the adoption of Ordinance 33 of 2024 amending zoning of properties at 2760, 2800, and 2828 North 2200 West from AG-2 to M-1, resetting a development agreement deadline to February 4, 2026, and approved the appointment of Alyn Toalepai to the Business Advisory Board through December 31, 2029.
